rows.title: The overview of a germinal products notification, with packages and kilograms totals in place of the animals count
rows.detail: Each germinal products notification needs an overview of its own in the germinal products set, showing the live-animals overview's content with the germinal differences. Germinal products are counted by packages and weight, not by animals, so the commodities block shows a packages card and a kilograms card instead of the animals card, and the kilograms card totals the gross weight entered for the consignment. Screen-reader users get the same named regions as on the live-animals overview, with the weight card named for the gross weight the set holds. The live-animals overview is unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: A germinal products notification has its own overview page in the germinal products set, keyed by that notification as the live-animals overview is, reached from the dashboard's link to the notification, and showing the 'Overview' heading, the notification's status tag and reference, the numbered task list and the 'Review and submit' and 'Return to dashboard' buttons (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-006, p1-008, p1-009, p1-011, p1-012; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p2-056; repo:frontend p4-001; trace:animals-fit p4-001)

On a germinal products notification's overview, 'Your commodities' shows the 'Packages/boxes' card and a card labelled 'Kilograms' with the caption 'Total weight of packages in this consignment' (prototype:dr2-1-source p12-013; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p12-147, p11-105)
On a germinal products notification's overview, 'Your commodities' shows exactly two cards: 'Packages/boxes' and 'Kilograms' (prototype:dr2-1-source p12-013; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-022, p1-023)
The 'Kilograms' card reads '0' before any gross weight is entered, and whenever the total is not a positive number (prototype:dr2-1-source p12-016)

The 'Kilograms' card totals the gross weight in kilograms entered for the consignment, showing a whole-number total as entered, for example '12' for 5 and 7, and any other total rounded to 3 decimal places, for example '2.5' for 1.25 and 1.25 (prototype:dr2-1-source p12-016; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-022)

On a germinal products notification's overview the 'Packages/boxes' card is a region named 'Packages summary' and the 'Kilograms' card a region named 'Gross weight summary' (prototype:dr2-1-source p12-013; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p11-013-m1; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-022)

On a germinal products notification's overview the 'Your commodities' block, the task list and each numbered section are regions named by their own heading (trace:prototype-dr2-1 p11-013-m1; prototype:dr2-1-source p12-013)
A live animals notification's overview shows the 'Animals' and 'Packages/boxes' cards and exactly those two cards (trace:animals-fit p4-008)

A germinal products notification's overview, both with zero totals and with packages and weights entered, has no serious or critical WCAG 2 A or AA accessibility violations (repo:frontend p4-067, p4-068)
notes: Combines the germinal overview page itself (req-1836) with its three differences from the live-animals overview: the swapped commodity cards (req-788), the gross weight display rule (req-789) and the germinal card and block regions (req-1837). One page copy, one set-up, one review; building the cards or the regions apart would copy the page twice.

existingRow inc-099 already carries these four requirements and also holds req-1763, the germinal Commodity details Complete rule from the commodities area. The combiner should keep inc-099's id, its theme (germinal-products), its dependencies on inc-017 and inc-177, and merge this draft with the commodities area's draft for the row, removing repeats.

The page is copied from the live-animals overview after this programme has changed it, as ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-014 directs, which is why the germinal-products theme lands after overview-and-review.

c-128 ruled: each set keeps a per-notification overview in its own path shape, and the prototype's single session-scoped hub address is set aside. c-022 ruled: the weight the set holds is a total gross weight in kilograms, as a decimal. c-244 ruled: the weight card's region is named 'Gross weight summary' while its visible label stays 'Kilograms'.
Criterion 1 names no file, and the live-animals criterion is a regression check on a page this row does not change.

rows.title: Consignment parties on a germinal products notification's overview: one roles and addresses row, complete on the consignment addresses alone
rows.detail: A trader filling in a germinal products notification needs the overview to tell them what is left to do for the parties of the consignment. The germinal set asks only for the five consignment addresses, because it has no county parish holding number and no permanent address page, so its 'Consignment parties' section holds a single row with the same wording and hint as the live-animals overview, and that row is complete as soon as the consignment addresses are complete.
acceptanceCriteria: On a germinal products notification's overview, section 'Consignment parties' holds the single row 'Roles and addresses' with the hint 'Consignor or Exporter, Consignee, Importer and Place of Destination' (prototype:dr2-1-source p12-034, p12-035; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p12-152)

On a germinal products notification's overview, the 'Roles and addresses' row reads 'Complete' once all five consignment addresses are chosen, and 'To do' while any of them is missing (prototype:dr2-1-source p12-034; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-017, p1-018; repo:frontend p4-046)
notes: One slice: the overview's own view of the germinal consignment parties section. The row's completion rule can only be observed once the germinal roles and addresses page and its pickers exist.

existingRow inc-181 already carries req-1840 alongside the germinal roles and addresses page and party pickers (req-1826, req-1827, req-1832, req-1833) from the consignment-parties and cph-permanent-and-contact areas, which is the right home: building this row's criteria apart would copy that page twice. The combiner should keep inc-181's id, its theme (germinal-products), its dependencies on inc-091 and inc-054, and merge this draft into it, removing repeats.

The hint wording is the live-animals one, kept word for word (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-014). The row covers the consignment addresses only because ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-017 and p1-018 leave the county parish holding number and permanent address pages out of the germinal set.

rows.title: Transit countries on a germinal products notification's overview, shown in the arrival section only when they are required
rows.detail: A trader importing germinal products through another country needs to see the transit countries task on the overview, so they know it is outstanding. The task shows in the arrival section between arrival details and transport details whenever transit countries are required for the notification, is absent when they are not, and reads complete once a transit country is chosen. What makes transit countries required is decided elsewhere; this row is the overview's view of it.
acceptanceCriteria: When transit countries are required for a germinal products notification, section 3 of its overview shows 'Transit countries' between 'Arrival details' and 'Transport details' (prototype:dr2-1-source p12-030; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p12-150)

When transit countries are not required for a germinal products notification, section 3 of its overview shows 'Arrival details' followed by 'Transport details' (prototype:dr2-1-source p12-030; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-057)

Where it is shown, a germinal products notification's 'Transit countries' task reads 'To do' until at least one transit country is selected, then 'Complete' (prototype:dr2-1-source p12-030; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-014)
notes: One slice: the germinal half of the overview's transit countries task, split from its live-animals half by ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 13. The rule that decides when transit countries are required belongs to the arrival-and-transit area, and the task needs the germinal set's own transit countries page, so this row cannot be observed before that page exists.

existingRow inc-182 already carries req-1839 with the rest of the germinal journey (req-1898, req-182), which is the right home: that row builds the germinal arrival, transit countries and review pages the criteria read. The combiner should keep inc-182's id, its theme (germinal-products), its dependencies and its external dependencies, and merge this draft into it, removing repeats.
Criterion 2 states what the arrival section shows rather than what it omits, so a reviewer checks a positive order.
